component.name: Kaeru
component.summary: Keep awake, focus timer and honest work log

description.p: Kaeru keeps your machine awake on request, runs focus intervals (single countdown or Pomodoro) and records an honest work log with suspend-aware, suspend-exclusive accounting. It uses the desktop's own mechanisms (xdg-desktop-portal Inhibit, with a logind fallback) and never synthesizes input activity or modifies global power settings.
Everything is local: an SQLite work log under $XDG_DATA_HOME/kaeru, CSV export with spreadsheet formula-injection protection, and a diagnostics page that reports honestly what works on your system.
First packaged development release: keep awake (portal/logind), focus timer, work log storage, reports and CSV export, tray, Debian package.
